title: Non-materializing Fusion COUNT prefix
description: Optimize FusionTransaction::count_prefix so COUNT(*) can count visible keys without allocating a Vec of every matching key/value pair.
constraints: Preserve scan_range MVCC visibility, tombstone and de-dup semantics
Keep the change limited to database core behavior and focused tests
convergence_criteria: FusionTransaction::count_prefix no longer calls scan_range just to count
scan_range and count_prefix share the same visible-range merge logic
A focused FusionStorage count_prefix regression test passes
Existing SELECT COUNT(*) integration test passes
